scope: Instruction-derived Windows engine contract for the invisible model-shadow carrier terrain exclusion. This record is frozen evidence, not an in-game outcome.

executable.source_path: Owned local game executable; personal path omitted.

defect.trigger: A shadow-only prop has a 64-metre slanted carrier and conservative enlarged OccupantSize bounds, but lacks property 0x29F013E6 with value true.
defect.effect: The native immovability filter includes the prop, allowing its artificial bounds to block terrain-height changes outside the visible highway geometry.
defect.physics_marker_is_insufficient: Property 0x029244DB with Bool false excludes the helper from static-body creation by property presence, but the immovability filter reads the separate 0x29F013E6 Bool value.

required_helper_property.applies_to: Invisible shadow carrier props only; existing visible props remain unchanged.

native_filter.behavior: For prop, building, power-pole, and network occupant types, read property 0x29F013E6 with default false, and return the logical negation. A true value excludes the helper from immovability checks.
native_filter.terrain_consumer: ModifyTerrainHeight at 00467bb0 uses this filter before testing occupant bounds.

complete_property_reference_scan.method: Search the owned executable for the little-endian four-byte property identifier, resolve file offsets to virtual addresses, and inspect each surrounding native instruction path. No executable bytes are reproduced.

references.role: Only native read: immovability Bool test.

limits: Static instruction analysis and resource semantics establish the required helper property; no live terrain-tool execution was performed.
This does not authorize moving or removing the physical highway, its visible props, or its traffic paths.
Other placement, query, renderer, and lifecycle behavior require their own bounded checks.
